claim: Meijiawu is less famous than Longjing Village but more pleasant to visit, with a broader valley and more extensive tea fields; farmers welcome visitors to pick tea for a small fee.
quote: Meijiawu is less famous than Longjing Village and significantly more pleasant to visit. The valley setting is broader, the tea fields are more extensive. ... Most farmers in Meijiawu welcome visitors to pick tea during harvest season for a small participation fee (¥50 to ¥100 for 30 to 60 minutes).

claim: Authentic West Lake Longjing runs roughly ¥80-200/100g standard and ¥300+/100g for the pre-Qingming first flush; avoid suspiciously cheap tea near West Lake tourist areas.
quote: Never buy from vendors near West Lake's main tourist areas. ... Suspiciously cheap tea (¥30/100g) is fake.

claim: The Shili Langdang trail runs Jiuxi -> Longjing Village -> Shili Langdang -> Yunqi Bamboo Path, ~10km with 350-470m gain, 3-5 hours, beginner-friendly, passing tea gardens, West Lake panoramas and bamboo forest.
quote: Jiuxi -> Longjing Village -> Shili Langdang -> Yunqi Bamboo Path ... Distance: Approximately 10 km ... Elevation Gain: Around 350-470 meters ... Duration: 3-5 hours ... Difficulty: Two stars (beginner-friendly, mostly gentle slopes)

claim: Shili Langdang sits within the West Lake circle trail's ~10km bamboo-and-tea-garden section from the China National Tea Museum to the Yunqi bamboo path; the full circuit is about 42.5km.
quote: Walking on the road surrounded with bamboo seas to find ancient sites, the spot Shili Tanglang suddenly shows up at the distance. ... about 85 li, or 42.5 kilometers

claim: Xixi Wetland (~11 sq km) is best in spring/autumn for birdwatching (200+ bird species), with boat rides the signature experience, a Feb-Mar plum blossom festival and an autumn square-persimmon picking festival; entry CNY 80, cruise CNY 60.
quote: Xixi Wetland is truly a birdwatcher's paradise, home to over 200 species of birds throughout the year. ... One of the best ways to experience Xixi Wetland is through a serene boat ride along its peaceful waterways. ... Entrance fee: CNY 80; Sightseeing cruise: CNY 60.

claim: Hangzhou's tea-picking season runs roughly late March to early November, with the prized first flush around late March to early April peaking at the Qingming Festival (early April) which draws heavy crowds.
quote: tea-picking season in Hangzhou usually spans from late March to early November ... the traditional Qingming Festival happens around early April, which brings a peak tourist time

claim: Beigao Peak (314m) can be hiked free via the Lingyin back-door bamboo route or reached by cable car (30 RMB up/20 down); the summit holds Lingshun Temple (8 RMB) and a viewing platform with panoramic West Lake and city views.
quote: Elevation: 314 meters ... Cable Car: One-way uphill costs 30 RMB; downhill is 20 RMB ... Lingshun Ancient Temple crowns the peak. Admission is 8 RMB ... an unobstructed panoramic view of West Lake, the cityscape of Hangzhou
